title: Profile
description: A preflight profile: the checks FileCheck runs on an uploaded file, each with its settings (target), how a failure is judged (severity) and whether it is repaired automatically. There are two kinds. A PDF profile (kind omitted or 'pdf') checks PDFs, and vector and office files once converted to PDF; its checks sit in the sections geometry (geom.*), color (color.*), text (text.*), images (image.*) and structure (struct.*). A raster profile (kind: 'raster') checks image uploads (JPEG, PNG, TIFF and so on) with the single section raster (raster.*). An upload rule points at profiles through rule.accepts[].preflight.profileId: pdf, vector and office accepts need a PDF profile, raster accepts a raster profile. A check runs only when both its section's enabled and its own enabled are true; everything omitted is off. Each check has a severity. reject: a failing file is rejected (shown as a warning instead when the upload rule's onFail is not reject). warn: it passes with a warning. ignore: the finding is recorded but never fails or warns. autofix: the customer is told FileCheck repairs it, and the finding is judged as reject when this file is beyond the repair; autofix is accepted only on checks that have a repair (their description says Autofix: …). Repairs run only in workflows with an autofix step, which repairs every failed check that has a repair whatever its severity, so to stop a repair disable the check. Units are in the field names: _mm millimetres, _pt points (1/72 in), _dpi or dpi pixels per inch, percent, _px pixels, _mb megabytes. Unknown check ids, a check in the wrong section and misspelled settings are refused.

title.description: Name shown in the dashboard and in the profile picker of upload rules, e.g. 'Business cards 85 x 55 mm'. Keep it under 45 characters, the dashboard editor's limit; the dashboard will not save a profile without one.

description.description: Note for the print shop: what the profile is for. Shown in the dashboard editor of PDF profiles; never shown to customers.

kind.description: 'raster' for an image profile; 'pdf' or omitted for a PDF profile. Decides which sections are valid: changing it on an existing profile means replacing its sections too, and upload rules pointing at it must match the new kind.

metadata.description: Legacy metadata carried by built-in catalog profiles.

kind.description: Legacy copy of kind. Must agree with kind; 'raster' here without kind: 'raster' is refused because the dashboard would open the profile as a PDF profile and drop its raster checks.

description.description: Catalog blurb of built-in profiles; not shown anywhere. Use description instead.

tags.description: Free-form labels for your own organisation, e.g. ['business-cards', 'cmyk']. Not shown to customers.

sections.description: The checks, grouped in sections keyed by section id. PDF profiles: geometry (geom.* checks), color (color.*), text (text.*), images (image.*), structure (struct.*) and page_rules (reserved, keep empty). Raster profiles: raster (raster.*). Each section is { enabled, rules: { <check id>: { enabled, severity, target, autofixStrategy } } }. To change one setting, PATCH only that path, e.g. { "sections": { "geometry": { "rules": { "geom.bleed.required": { "target": { "required_mm": 3 } } } } } }; when enabling a check, also send its section's enabled: true.

noTarget.description: This check has no settings: omit target, or send null or {}.

ruleEnabled.description: true runs this check; false or omitted leaves it off. Its section's enabled must also be true.

legacyMessage.description: Legacy free-text note stored by older dashboards. Not shown to customers (their messages come from FileCheck's built-in text for each check id); leave null or omit.

sectionEnabled.description: Must be true for any check in this section to run: the runtime skips the whole section otherwise, whatever the checks say. Keep it true exactly when at least one check is enabled, as the dashboard does; it is refused as false or missing while a check in the section is enabled.

geom.page_count.description: Number of pages. Fails when the count is not one of allowed (if set), or is below min or above max; every limit you set must hold. A page count chosen on the storefront product page replaces min and max for that order. No automatic repair.

id.description: The check id, 'geom.page_count'. Optional; must equal the key.

severity.description: reject, warn or ignore. Omitted = warn. autofix is refused: this check has no repair, and an autofix finding would promise the customer a fix that never happens.

autofixStrategy.description: Display label for the repair. No label exists for this check: leave it null or omit it.

target.description: Settings for this check. Omitted fields use the defaults described on each field.

min.description: Fewest pages accepted. null or omitted = no lower limit.

max.description: Most pages accepted. null or omitted = no upper limit.

allowed.description: Exact page counts accepted, e.g. [1, 2] for one- or two-sided. Empty or omitted = any count within min and max.

geom.page_size.description: Finished page size. Each page's trim size (its TrimBox when it has one, else the visible page) must match one of allowed within tolerance_mm, in either orientation. A page with no TrimBox that is an allowed size plus an even margin on every side is read as trim + bleed when geom.bleed.required asks for bleed on all sides. A size chosen on the storefront product page replaces allowed for that order. Autofix: rescales the document to the nearest allowed size when every page misses by no more than autofix_within_percent and all pages need the same size; with fit_mode on, fits each page onto the product size instead. A file beyond the repair is judged as reject.

id.description: The check id, 'geom.page_size'. Optional; must equal the key.

severity.description: reject, warn, ignore or autofix (FileCheck repairs it; judged as reject when this file is beyond the repair). Omitted = warn. Severity only decides how a failure is judged: a workflow autofix step repairs every failed check that has a repair, whatever its severity.

autofixStrategy.description: Display label for the repair, shown in the dashboard; the runtime picks the repair from the check id and ignores this field. Known labels: 'rescale-page'. null or omitted is fine.

target.description: Settings for this check. Omitted fields use the defaults described on each field.

allowed.description: Accepted finished (trim) sizes in millimetres, without bleed. Either orientation passes: 85 x 55 also accepts 55 x 85. US sizes in mm: 8.5 x 11 in = 215.9 x 279.4. Required (non-empty) when the check is enabled.

tolerance_mm.description: How far, in mm, each side may differ from an allowed size and still pass. Default 0.5.

autofix_within_percent.description: Near-miss rescale window, in percent of the size: the repair rescales only pages within this distance of an allowed size. Default 10; 0 is read as 10, so to keep the rescale from ever applying use a tiny value such as 0.1. Ignored when fit_mode is on.

fit_mode.description: Fit to product size, for files of any size. off (default): only the near-miss rescale. contain: scale the design to fit inside the product, whole design visible, gaps filled per fit_fill. cover: scale to fill the product, overflow cropped.

fit_fill.description: With fit_mode on: mirror (default) fills gaps and bleed by reflecting the artwork edges; white leaves gaps white and mirrors only the bleed where artwork meets the cut.

fit_max_scale.description: With fit_mode on: the largest enlargement factor, and its reciprocal the largest reduction. Default 2 (from half to double size); files needing more are not repaired.

geom.sheet_size.description: Sheet size for roll and gang sheet products: a fixed width and any length up to a maximum (geom.page_size only accepts fixed sizes). Each page's finished size (the TrimBox when it has a usable one, else the page) is read either way round: one side must be width_mm within tolerance_mm, and the other side, the length, must fall within min_length_mm and max_length_mm. The width and length measured on page 1 are reported with the result, pass or fail (evaluation.measurements.sheet). No automatic repair.

id.description: The check id, 'geom.sheet_size'. Optional; must equal the key.

severity.description: reject, warn or ignore. Omitted = warn. autofix is refused: this check has no repair, and an autofix finding would promise the customer a fix that never happens.

autofixStrategy.description: Display label for the repair. No label exists for this check: leave it null or omit it.

target.description: Settings for this check. Omitted fields use the defaults described on each field.

width_mm.description: Sheet width in mm: the side that runs across the film or roll, e.g. 558.8 for 22 in DTF film. Required when the check is enabled.

max_length_mm.description: Longest accepted length in mm, e.g. 3048 for 120 in. null or omitted = no maximum. An order's context.artworkSize sets it to the chosen height_mm.

min_length_mm.description: Shortest accepted length in mm. null or omitted = no minimum. Leave it off for a billing minimum (a 3 in minimum charge is not a file defect).

tolerance_mm.description: Slack in mm on the length limits (and, for PDFs, on the width). Default 2.

geom.orientation.description: Page orientation: every page must be the allowed orientation (portrait = taller than wide, landscape = wider than tall, square = equal sides). No automatic repair.

id.description: The check id, 'geom.orientation'. Optional; must equal the key.

severity.description: reject, warn or ignore. Omitted = warn. autofix is refused: this check has no repair, and an autofix finding would promise the customer a fix that never happens.

autofixStrategy.description: Display label for the repair. No label exists for this check: leave it null or omit it.

target.description: Settings for this check. Omitted fields use the defaults described on each field.

allowed.description: The one orientation accepted. There is no 'any': to accept any orientation, disable the check (the value 'any' would fail every page). Required when the check is enabled.

geom.bleed.required.description: Bleed: how far the bleed area (BleedBox, else the page edge) extends past the trim (TrimBox) on each checked edge, which must be required_mm plus or minus tolerance_mm. Pages without a TrimBox are judged by their BleedBox margins, or read as trim + bleed when geom.page_size allows the inner size. Too much bleed fails too. Autofix: rebuilds the page boxes to exactly required_mm of bleed and fills the new strip per fill. Not offered for a document whose pages disagree.

id.description: The check id, 'geom.bleed.required'. Optional; must equal the key.

severity.description: reject, warn, ignore or autofix (FileCheck repairs it; judged as reject when this file is beyond the repair). Omitted = warn. Severity only decides how a failure is judged: a workflow autofix step repairs every failed check that has a repair, whatever its severity.

autofixStrategy.description: Display label for the repair, shown in the dashboard; the runtime picks the repair from the check id and ignores this field. Known labels: 'add-bleed'. null or omitted is fine.

target.description: Settings for this check. Omitted fields use the defaults described on each field.

required_mm.description: Bleed each checked edge must have, in mm, e.g. 3 (1/8 in = 3.175). Default 3.

tolerance_mm.description: Allowed difference from required_mm, in mm, either way. Default 0.2.

sides.description: Edges to check: ['all'] (default) or any of 'top', 'right', 'bottom', 'left'. Empty = all edges.

fill.description: How the repair fills the new bleed strip. none (default): only sets the page boxes, for artwork that already runs past the trim. mirror: reflects the edge artwork into the strip. scale: enlarges the page content slightly to cover it.

geom.bleed.content_coverage.description: Artwork in the bleed: whether the printed content really extends required_mm past the trim (or reaches the page edge when there is no TrimBox), so no white slivers show after cutting. Blank pages are skipped; crop marks outside the trim can hide a bare edge. Autofix: adds bleed by mirroring or scaling the edge artwork. When geom.bleed.required fails on the same file one bleed pass runs and the first fill seen wins (normally geom.bleed.required's), so give that check a fill of mirror or scale too.

id.description: The check id, 'geom.bleed.content_coverage'. Optional; must equal the key.

severity.description: reject, warn, ignore or autofix (FileCheck repairs it; judged as reject when this file is beyond the repair). Omitted = warn. Severity only decides how a failure is judged: a workflow autofix step repairs every failed check that has a repair, whatever its severity.

autofixStrategy.description: Display label for the repair, shown in the dashboard; the runtime picks the repair from the check id and ignores this field. Known labels: 'add-bleed'. null or omitted is fine.

target.description: Settings for this check. Omitted fields use the defaults described on each field.

required_mm.description: How far artwork must extend past the trim on each checked edge, in mm. Default 3.

tolerance_mm.description: How much short of required_mm still passes, in mm. Default 0.5.

sides.description: Edges to check: ['all'] (default) or any of 'top', 'right', 'bottom', 'left'. Empty = all edges.

fill.description: How the repair synthesises artwork in the strip: mirror (default) reflects the edge artwork, scale enlarges the content slightly.

geom.trim.required.description: Trim box: every page must declare a TrimBox inset from the page edge (MediaBox) by required_mm plus or minus tolerance_mm on each checked edge; a page without one fails. For bleed use geom.bleed.required. Autofix: sets the TrimBox to the MediaBox inset by required_mm on all four edges (sides is not applied to the repair).

id.description: The check id, 'geom.trim.required'. Optional; must equal the key.

severity.description: reject, warn, ignore or autofix (FileCheck repairs it; judged as reject when this file is beyond the repair). Omitted = warn. Severity only decides how a failure is judged: a workflow autofix step repairs every failed check that has a repair, whatever its severity.

autofixStrategy.description: Display label for the repair, shown in the dashboard; the runtime picks the repair from the check id and ignores this field. Known labels: 'add-trim'. null or omitted is fine.

target.description: Settings for this check. Omitted fields use the defaults described on each field.

required_mm.description: Inset of the TrimBox from the page edge, in mm. Default 0 (trim at the page edge).

tolerance_mm.description: Allowed difference from required_mm, in mm, either way. Default 0.2.

sides.description: Edges to check: ['all'] (default) or any of 'top', 'right', 'bottom', 'left'. Empty = all edges.

geom.safety_margin.description: Safe zone: flags text placed closer than min_mm to the trim edge. Only text is measured, not images or shapes. It shares one measurement with text.edge_safe_zone: when both are enabled the larger distance applies to both. No automatic repair.

id.description: The check id, 'geom.safety_margin'. Optional; must equal the key.

severity.description: reject, warn or ignore. Omitted = warn. autofix is refused: this check has no repair, and an autofix finding would promise the customer a fix that never happens.

target.description: Settings for this check. Omitted fields use the defaults described on each field.

min_mm.description: Minimum distance of text from the trim edge, in mm, e.g. 3 to 5. Omitted = the analyzer default, 3 mm (8.5 pt).

geom.rotation.description: Page rotation: each page's viewer rotation (/Rotate) must be one of allowed. Autofix: bakes the rotation into the content so pages become upright (0) and look the same. Only possible when 0 is allowed.

id.description: The check id, 'geom.rotation'. Optional; must equal the key.

geom.consistent_page_sizes.description: Mixed page sizes: fails when the pages are not all the same size (compared to 0.01 mm). No automatic repair.

id.description: The check id, 'geom.consistent_page_sizes'. Optional; must equal the key.

id.description: The check id, 'geom.spread_vs_single'. Optional; must equal the key.

mode.description: Expected layout: single pages, spreads, or either. Stored only.

section.geometry.description: Page geometry checks for PDF files: page count, finished size, orientation, bleed, trim box, safe zone, rotation. Check ids start with 'geom.'.

id.description: The section id, 'geometry'. Optional; must equal the key.

title.description: Display title in the dashboard, e.g. 'Page Checks'. Cosmetic.

rules.description: The checks of this section, keyed by check id: geom.page_count, geom.page_size, geom.sheet_size, geom.orientation, geom.bleed.required, geom.bleed.content_coverage, geom.trim.required, geom.safety_margin, geom.rotation, geom.consistent_page_sizes, geom.spread_vs_single. Any other key is refused. Omitted checks are off.

color.mode.description: Colour modes of page content and images: fails when anything is painted in a mode not in allowed. Spot colours (Separation, DeviceN), patterns and indexed images are not judged here; see color.spot_colors. Autofix: converts the document to the highest-priority allowed mode: CMYK, else grayscale, else RGB. Needs one of those in allowed (not possible for lab alone).

id.description: The check id, 'color.mode'. Optional; must equal the key.

severity.description: reject, warn, ignore or autofix (FileCheck repairs it; judged as reject when this file is beyond the repair). Omitted = warn. Severity only decides how a failure is judged: a workflow autofix step repairs every failed check that has a repair, whatever its severity.

autofixStrategy.description: Display label for the repair. No label exists for this check: leave it null or omit it.

target.description: Settings for this check. Omitted fields use the defaults described on each field.

allowed.description: Accepted colour modes, e.g. ['cmyk'] or ['cmyk', 'grayscale'] for print. Required (non-empty) when the check is enabled.

convertSpecialSpaces.description: Repair: also convert spot (Separation, DeviceN) and ICC-based colours. Default true; set false to keep spot colours printed as separate inks, or list them in preserve.

preserve.description: Repair: colour spaces left unconverted: icc (ICC-based), separation, separationAll, deviceN, nchannel.

color.max_ink_coverage.description: Total ink coverage (TAC): flags pages where the sum of cyan, magenta, yellow and black at any point exceeds percent. No automatic repair.

id.description: The check id, 'color.max_ink_coverage'. Optional; must equal the key.

severity.description: reject, warn or ignore. Omitted = warn. autofix is refused: this check has no repair, and an autofix finding would promise the customer a fix that never happens.

percent.description: Maximum total ink in percent (0 to 400), e.g. 300 for coated stock, lower for uncoated paper or newsprint. Default 300.

color.spot_colors.description: Spot colours: fails when the file uses more than max_count spot (named) colours that are not in whitelist. No automatic repair.

id.description: The check id, 'color.spot_colors'. Optional; must equal the key.

severity.description: reject, warn or ignore. Omitted = warn. autofix is refused: this check has no repair, and an autofix finding would promise the customer a fix that never happens.

whitelist.description: Spot colour names always accepted, matched exactly and case-sensitively, e.g. 'PANTONE 186 C'. They do not count toward max_count.

max_count.description: How many other spot colours are tolerated. Default 0: any spot colour outside the whitelist fails.

color.output_intent_required.description: Output intent: the PDF must declare the print condition its colours were prepared for, as PDF/X files do. With expected_profile_name it must also match that condition. Autofix: embeds icc_alias (else expected_profile_name, read as an ICC alias) as the output intent. Needs one of the two.

id.description: The check id, 'color.output_intent_required'. Optional; must equal the key.

severity.description: reject, warn, ignore or autofix (FileCheck repairs it; judged as reject when this file is beyond the repair). Omitted = warn. Severity only decides how a failure is judged: a workflow autofix step repairs every failed check that has a repair, whatever its severity.

target.description: Settings for this check. Omitted fields use the defaults described on each field.

expected_profile_name.description: Required print condition, matched case-insensitively as part of the file's OutputConditionIdentifier, OutputCondition or Info, e.g. 'FOGRA39' or 'GRACoL'. Empty or null = any output intent passes. The dashboard stores an ICC alias here; hyphenated aliases such as 'iso-coated-v2' rarely appear in files, so set icc_alias for the repair and a plain identifier here.

icc_alias.description: Repair: the ICC profile embedded as the output intent. Preferred over expected_profile_name. FileCheck ICC aliases: fogra39 (Coated FOGRA39), fogra51 (PSO Coated v3), fogra52 (PSO Uncoated v3), fogra29 (Uncoated FOGRA29), iso-coated-v2, iso-coated-v2-300 (300 % ink cap), gracol2013, gracol2006, swop2013, swop (US Web Coated SWOP v2), japan-coated, japan-uncoated, psr-lwc, psr-snp (newsprint), srgb, adobe-rgb, display-p3, greyscale.

output_condition_identifier.description: Repair: OutputConditionIdentifier written with the embedded intent, e.g. 'FOGRA39'.

color.icc_profile.description: Embedded ICC profiles: fails when the file embeds an ICC profile whose name is not in whitelist. Empty whitelist = the check does nothing. No automatic repair.

id.description: The check id, 'color.icc_profile'. Optional; must equal the key.

raster.effective_dpi.description: Print resolution (keep raster.min_dimensions_px off when using this): the image's pixels divided by its print size in inches must reach min_dpi. The print size is target_width_mm/target_height_mm, else the size chosen on the order, else the workflow's Convert page size; with none of them the check does not run. The DPI written in the file header is never used. With raster.sheet_size on, the print size is the sheet: pixels across / its width_mm, on the side that check reads as the width. Autofix: upscales the image with AI until it reaches min_dpi at the print size.

raster.sheet_size.description: Sheet length for image gang sheets: a fixed width (width_mm, the film) and any length up to a maximum. An image has no physical size, so the width is taken as given and the length is width_mm x the pixels along the sheet / the pixels across it. Which side runs across is read from the customer's answer (across), else the header resolution when it makes exactly one side measure width_mm (an orientation hint only), else the reading whose resolution is plausible next to raster.effective_dpi's min_dpi (300 when that check is off). When both readings are plausible the result says ambiguous, so the storefront can ask the customer. With this check on, raster.effective_dpi measures pixels across / width_mm on the same reading. The measured width, length and orientation are reported with the result, pass or fail (evaluation.measurements.sheet). No automatic repair.

id.description: The check id, 'raster.sheet_size'. Optional; must equal the key.

max_length_mm.description: Longest accepted length in mm, e.g. 3048 for 120 in. null or omitted = no maximum. An order's context.artworkSize sets it to the chosen height_mm.

min_length_mm.description: Shortest accepted length in mm. null or omitted = no minimum. Leave it off for a billing minimum (a 3 in minimum charge is not a file defect).

tolerance_mm.description: Slack in mm on the length limits (and, for PDFs, on the width). Default 2.

across.description: Which side of the image runs across the film, when the customer has said so: 'short' or 'long'. null or omitted = decided from the file. Normally set per order through context.sheet.across, not in the profile.

raster.colorspace.description: Image colour mode: fails when the decoded image's mode (rgb, cmyk, grayscale or lab) is not in allowed. Autofix: converts to the highest-priority allowed mode: CMYK, else grayscale, else RGB, through iccAlias when set. Needs one of those in allowed.

id.description: The check id, 'raster.colorspace'. Optional; must equal the key.

severity.description: reject, warn, ignore or autofix (FileCheck repairs it; judged as reject when this file is beyond the repair). Omitted = warn. Severity only decides how a failure is judged: a workflow autofix step repairs every failed check that has a repair, whatever its severity.

autofixStrategy.description: Display label for the repair, shown in the dashboard; the runtime picks the repair from the check id and ignores this field. Known labels: 'cmyk-convert'. null or omitted is fine.

target.description: Settings for this check. Omitted fields use the defaults described on each field.

allowed.description: Accepted colour modes, e.g. ['rgb', 'cmyk'] for a photo lab, ['cmyk'] for offset. Required (non-empty) when the check is enabled.

iccAlias.description: Repair: ICC profile used for the conversion; pick one matching the target mode (a CMYK profile for CMYK). FileCheck ICC aliases: fogra39 (Coated FOGRA39), fogra51 (PSO Coated v3), fogra52 (PSO Uncoated v3), fogra29 (Uncoated FOGRA29), iso-coated-v2, iso-coated-v2-300 (300 % ink cap), gracol2013, gracol2006, swop2013, swop (US Web Coated SWOP v2), japan-coated, japan-uncoated, psr-lwc, psr-snp (newsprint), srgb, adobe-rgb, display-p3, greyscale.

raster.bit_depth.description: Bit depth: fails when the image has fewer than min bits per channel. Autofix: converts the image to at least min bits per channel.

id.description: The check id, 'raster.bit_depth'. Optional; must equal the key.

severity.description: reject, warn, ignore or autofix (FileCheck repairs it; judged as reject when this file is beyond the repair). Omitted = warn. Severity only decides how a failure is judged: a workflow autofix step repairs every failed check that has a repair, whatever its severity.

autofixStrategy.description: Display label for the repair. No label exists for this check: leave it null or omit it.

target.description: Settings for this check. Omitted fields use the defaults described on each field.

min.description: Minimum bits per channel: 1, 4, 8 or 16 (usually 8). Required when the check is enabled.

raster.transparency.description: Transparency: with allowed false, flags images that have an alpha channel. With allowed true or omitted the check does nothing. Autofix: flattens the image onto background.

id.description: The check id, 'raster.transparency'. Optional; must equal the key.

severity.description: reject, warn, ignore or autofix (FileCheck repairs it; judged as reject when this file is beyond the repair). Omitted = warn. Severity only decides how a failure is judged: a workflow autofix step repairs every failed check that has a repair, whatever its severity.

autofixStrategy.description: Display label for the repair, shown in the dashboard; the runtime picks the repair from the check id and ignores this field. Known labels: 'remove-alpha', 'flatten-background'. null or omitted is fine.

target.description: Settings for this check. Omitted fields use the defaults described on each field.

allowed.description: false flags transparent images; true accepts them. Required when the check is enabled.

background.description: Repair: colour the image is flattened onto, as #rrggbb. Default #ffffff (white).

raster.transparent_background.description: Transparent background, for DTF and other white-ink processes where anything opaque prints: fails when the image has no alpha channel, or when less than min_transparent_pct of its pixels are transparent (alpha 8/255 or lower), which catches a PNG saved with an alpha channel over a solid background. Coverage is measured on a downsample of at most about 4 megapixels. Images only. No automatic repair: removing a background changes the art. Unrelated to raster.transparency, which flags transparency on products that cannot print it.

id.description: The check id, 'raster.transparent_background'. Optional; must equal the key.

severity.description: reject, warn or ignore. Omitted = warn. autofix is refused: this check has no repair, and an autofix finding would promise the customer a fix that never happens.

autofixStrategy.description: Display label for the repair. No label exists for this check: leave it null or omit it.

target.description: Settings for this check. Omitted fields use the defaults described on each field.

min_transparent_pct.description: Least share of transparent pixels, in percent. Default 1: any real gap between designs passes, a full background fails. 0 only requires an alpha channel.

raster.background_removal.description: Background removal, a requested transform rather than a defect: with remove true, every upload that has no transparency yet gets its background removed by AI. Severity must be autofix. Autofix: removes the background with AI.

id.description: The check id, 'raster.background_removal'. Optional; must equal the key.

severity.description: Must be 'autofix': reject, warn, ignore or autofix (FileCheck repairs it; judged as reject when this file is beyond the repair). Omitted = warn. Severity only decides how a failure is judged: a workflow autofix step repairs every failed check that has a repair, whatever its severity.

autofixStrategy.description: Display label for the repair, shown in the dashboard; the runtime picks the repair from the check id and ignores this field. Known labels: 'remove-bg'. null or omitted is fine.

target.description: Settings for this check. Omitted fields use the defaults described on each field.

remove.description: true to remove backgrounds. Required (true) when the check is enabled.

raster.max_file_size.description: File size: fails when the image file is larger than max_mb megabytes. No automatic repair.

id.description: The check id, 'raster.max_file_size'. Optional; must equal the key.

severity.description: reject, warn or ignore. Omitted = warn. autofix is refused: this check has no repair, and an autofix finding would promise the customer a fix that never happens.

autofixStrategy.description: Display label for the repair. No label exists for this check: leave it null or omit it.

target.description: Settings for this check. Omitted fields use the defaults described on each field.

max_mb.description: Largest file accepted, in MB (1 MB = 1,048,576 bytes). Required when the check is enabled.

raster.icc_profile_required.description: Embedded colour profile: with 'any', fails when the image has no embedded ICC profile; with an alias, fails unless that exact profile is embedded. Autofix: embeds expected_profile_name and converts the pixels to it; 'any' embeds fogra39, a CMYK profile, so an RGB photo becomes CMYK.

id.description: The check id, 'raster.icc_profile_required'. Optional; must equal the key.

severity.description: reject, warn, ignore or autofix (FileCheck repairs it; judged as reject when this file is beyond the repair). Omitted = warn. Severity only decides how a failure is judged: a workflow autofix step repairs every failed check that has a repair, whatever its severity.

autofixStrategy.description: Display label for the repair. No label exists for this check: leave it null or omit it.

target.description: Settings for this check. Omitted fields use the defaults described on each field.

expected_profile_name.description: 'any' or the ICC alias the image must carry. Required when the check is enabled. FileCheck ICC aliases: fogra39 (Coated FOGRA39), fogra51 (PSO Coated v3), fogra52 (PSO Uncoated v3), fogra29 (Uncoated FOGRA29), iso-coated-v2, iso-coated-v2-300 (300 % ink cap), gracol2013, gracol2006, swop2013, swop (US Web Coated SWOP v2), japan-coated, japan-uncoated, psr-lwc, psr-snp (newsprint), srgb, adobe-rgb, display-p3, greyscale.

raster.aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio: fails when the image's width divided by height is further than tolerance from every ratio in ratio, in either orientation. Autofix: pads the image (letterbox or pillarbox, nothing cropped) to the nearest allowed ratio, with tolerance 0.02 when none is set.

id.description: The check id, 'raster.aspect_ratio'. Optional; must equal the key.

severity.description: reject, warn, ignore or autofix (FileCheck repairs it; judged as reject when this file is beyond the repair). Omitted = warn. Severity only decides how a failure is judged: a workflow autofix step repairs every failed check that has a repair, whatever its severity.

autofixStrategy.description: Display label for the repair, shown in the dashboard; the runtime picks the repair from the check id and ignores this field. Known labels: 'crop'. null or omitted is fine.

target.description: Settings for this check. Omitted fields use the defaults described on each field.

ratio.description: Accepted ratios, each as a string 'W:H' (also 'W/H' or 'WxH'), e.g. ['3:2', '4:3'], or a number = width divided by height (1.5). Either orientation passes. A list of two whole numbers such as [3, 2] means the ratios 3:1 and 2:1, not 3:2, and is refused; [1, 1] (square) is fine. Required (non-empty) when the check is enabled.

tolerance.description: Allowed difference between the image's width/height and a ratio, e.g. 0.02. Omitted = exact match.

raster.stitch_set.description: Stitch several uploads into one image. NOT IMPLEMENTED: the check never reports and nothing is stitched. Autofix: none in practice (the check never fails).

id.description: The check id, 'raster.stitch_set'. Optional; must equal the key.

severity.description: reject, warn, ignore or autofix (FileCheck repairs it; judged as reject when this file is beyond the repair). Omitted = warn. Severity only decides how a failure is judged: a workflow autofix step repairs every failed check that has a repair, whatever its severity.

autofixStrategy.description: Display label for the repair, shown in the dashboard; the runtime picks the repair from the check id and ignores this field. Known labels: 'stitch'. null or omitted is fine.

target.description: Settings for this check. Omitted fields use the defaults described on each field.

raster.tac.description: Total ink of the image once converted to CMYK: fails when any pixel's cyan + magenta + yellow + black exceeds max_percent. Autofix: converts the image to CMYK through icc_alias, whose gamut mapping caps the ink.

id.description: The check id, 'raster.tac'. Optional; must equal the key.

severity.description: reject, warn, ignore or autofix (FileCheck repairs it; judged as reject when this file is beyond the repair). Omitted = warn. Severity only decides how a failure is judged: a workflow autofix step repairs every failed check that has a repair, whatever its severity.

autofixStrategy.description: Display label for the repair, shown in the dashboard; the runtime picks the repair from the check id and ignores this field. Known labels: 'icc-convert'. null or omitted is fine.

target.description: Settings for this check. Omitted fields use the defaults described on each field.

max_percent.description: Maximum total ink in percent. Default 300.

icc_alias.description: Repair: CMYK ICC profile used for the conversion. '' or omitted = iso-coated-v2-300 (300 % cap); e.g. fogra29 for uncoated stock. FileCheck ICC aliases: fogra39 (Coated FOGRA39), fogra51 (PSO Coated v3), fogra52 (PSO Uncoated v3), fogra29 (Uncoated FOGRA29), iso-coated-v2, iso-coated-v2-300 (300 % ink cap), gracol2013, gracol2006, swop2013, swop (US Web Coated SWOP v2), japan-coated, japan-uncoated, psr-lwc, psr-snp (newsprint), srgb, adobe-rgb, display-p3, greyscale.

section.raster.description: Checks on an uploaded image file (JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP and so on). Check ids start with 'raster.'.

id.description: The section id, 'raster'. Optional; must equal the key.

title.description: Display title in the dashboard, e.g. 'Raster Checks'. Cosmetic.

rules.description: The checks of this section, keyed by check id: raster.format, raster.min_dimensions_px, raster.max_dimensions_px, raster.effective_dpi, raster.sheet_size, raster.colorspace, raster.bit_depth, raster.transparency, raster.transparent_background, raster.background_removal, raster.max_file_size, raster.icc_profile_required, raster.aspect_ratio, raster.stitch_set, raster.tac. Any other key is refused. Omitted checks are off.

section.page_rules.description: Reserved for per-page overrides, which are not evaluated yet. The dashboard saves it empty: keep rules {} and entries [], or omit the section.

id.description: The section id, 'page_rules'.

enabled.description: Has no effect; the dashboard saves false.

entries.description: Always []: per-page overrides are not supported yet.

pdfSections.description: Sections of a PDF profile. Omitted sections are off.

rasterSections.description: Sections of a raster profile: only raster.
